advancedArguments.name: subordinates
advancedArguments.description: One or more direct reports (each a name or employee number) to submit this training need application for, e.g. ['John Silva'] or ['000010','000011']. Matches each entry first by exact employee number, then by a case-insensitive substring match against name, against the supervisor's live subordinate list. At least one is required. This is checked before anything else in this tool - the moment the supervisor names who the need is for, call this tool with ONLY subordinates (existingNeedName/newNeedName and the narrative fields all omitted) to validate them first; it's always safe since this call alone never submits anything. If any entry doesn't match exactly one subordinate, the tool returns NOT_SUBORDINATE or AMBIGUOUS (whichever applies) listing every problem entry plus eligibleSubordinates - fix all of them before ever asking about the need itself or narrative fields.

advancedArguments.name: existingNeedName
advancedArguments.description: The name (or partial name) of an already-existing training need category to attach this application to, e.g. 'Database & Data Management' - matches case-insensitively against the category list from getSupervisorTrainingNeeds' existingNeedCategories. Use this when the subordinate's need matches a category already on file (UAC 3.2) rather than describing something new. If more than one category matches, the tool returns status AMBIGUOUS with the candidates - ask which one and retry with the exact name. Either existingNeedName or newNeedName must be provided, not both. Only required once every named subordinate is already confirmed valid - do not collect or pass this on the subordinates-only validation call.

advancedArguments.name: newNeedName
advancedArguments.description: The requested need, in the supervisor's own words, when what's needed isn't already an existing category, e.g. 'Advanced Excel Macros' (UAC 3.3 - the 'Requested Need' field). Either existingNeedName or newNeedName must be provided, not both. Only required once every named subordinate is already confirmed valid - do not collect or pass this on the subordinates-only validation call.

advancedArguments.name: newNeedDescription

advancedArguments.name: objective
advancedArguments.description: The objective of this training need. Required - the training system itself rejects a submission without this (confirmed live: 'Please specify the objective.'). Unlike the self-application tool, there is no goal-linking option here (confirmed live: a real multi-subordinate submission sent IsGoalObject false with no ongoing-goals data at all) - always provide free text. Only enforced once every named subordinate is confirmed valid and the need is identified - do not ask the supervisor for this before that.
